convertibility_reason: Uses multiple MT5 Standard Library .mqh includes (Trade\PositionInfo.mqh, Trade\Trade.mqh, Trade\SymbolInfo.mqh, Trade\AccountInfo.mqh, Trade\DealInfo.mqh, Trade\OrderInfo.mqh, Expert\Money\MoneyFixedMargin.mqh) for position management and trade execution. While indicators are built-in (iMA only), the EA relies heavily on CTrade/CSymbolInfo/CAccountInfo wrapper classes for order execution and position management, requiring careful translation of Standard Library method calls to raw Python equivalents. The time-based intrabar entry logic with minute guards and the conditional stop-loss exit (not a simple SL/TP close) adds conversion complexity.

derived_values.name: EMA slope (derivative)
derived_values.used_by: Entry rules: SLOPE_SMALL <= ema_slope <= SLOPE_LARGE for long; -SLOPE_LARGE <= ema_slope <= -SLOPE_SMALL for short

derived_values.name: Adjusted point value
derived_values.used_by: All pip-based parameters (BIG_JUMP, DOUBLE_JUMP, STOP_LOSS, EMERGENCY_LOSS, TAKE_PROFIT, SLOPE_SMALL, SLOPE_LARGE, SLIP_BEGIN, SLIP_END, ADJUST)

additional_conditions: current bar close <= current bar open (bearish current bar)
current bar close <= current bar low + SLIP_BEGIN
no big jump in last 5 bars (BIG_JUMP check)
no double-jump in last 4 overlapping pairs (DOUBLE_JUMP check)
current bar close >= current bar open (bullish current bar)
current bar close >= current bar high - SLIP_BEGIN
no big jump in last 5 bars (BIG_JUMP check)
no double-jump in last 4 overlapping pairs (DOUBLE_JUMP check)

params.note: EMERGENCY_LOSS is the actual SL set on the order; STOP_LOSS=20 is a conditional soft stop implemented in OnTick logic that closes when additional time/price conditions are met

other_exits: Conditional soft stop-loss: if position is in loss by STOP_LOSS pips AND minute > MINUTES_END AND bar shows retracement signal (close vs open/high/low with SLIP_END tolerance), then close position
Volume-based exit: if previous bar volume <= MIN_VOLUME, close any open position
Duplicate prevention: if same-direction position exists, block new entry in that direction

time_filter.note: Uses minute-of-hour filter (MINUTES_BEGIN=25, MINUTES_END=25) rather than session filter. Entry allowed only when current minute > MINUTES_BEGIN. Soft SL exit allowed only when current minute > MINUTES_END.

custom_logic_notes: 1. EMA is calculated on H1 timeframe regardless of chart timeframe (hardcoded PERIOD_H1 in iMA call). 2. Entry uses a 'pullback within trend' pattern: EMA slope must be in a moderate range (not too flat, not too steep), then waits for a counter-trend bar at bar close near extreme (close near low for longs, close near high for shorts). 3. BIG_JUMP filter: checks 5 consecutive bar-to-bar opens for gaps >= 30 adjusted pips, zeroing all entry chances if any found. 4. DOUBLE_JUMP filter: checks 4 overlapping 2-bar spans for combined moves >= 55 adjusted pips. 5. The 'open_price' for SL comparison is stored as a static variable, calculated as bar open +/- ADJUST + spread at entry time, NOT the actual fill price. 6. EMERGENCY_LOSS (50 pips) is the hard SL on the order; STOP_LOSS (20 pips) is a soft conditional SL that only triggers when additional minute and price-reversal conditions are met. 7. ADJUST parameter (default 1 pip) is added/subtracted from bar open price to compute the reference open_price for SL comparison - described as 'imaginary spread adjustment'.
python_conversion_notes: 1. EMA indicator uses H1 timeframe hardcoded - must fetch H1 bars regardless of signal timeframe. 2. The soft stop-loss logic is NOT a trailing stop - it is a conditional exit that checks: position in loss by >= STOP_LOSS pips from reference open_price AND minute > MINUTES_END AND bar shows reversal candle. This requires tick-level monitoring. 3. The reference open_price is NOT the fill price but a computed value (bar_open - ADJUST + spread for longs, bar_open + ADJUST + spread for shorts). This must be stored per-position. 4. Big jump and double-jump filters scan 6 previous bars' open prices - need bar history buffer. 5. Minute-of-hour filter uses TimeCurrent().min (current minute within the hour), not a session time filter. 6. CTrade/CSymbolInfo/CAccountInfo Standard Library wrappers need to be replaced with direct broker API calls. 7. CMoneyFixedMargin is declared but never instantiated or used in OnInit/OnTick - can be ignored. 8. Volume exit check uses iVolume of previous bar (index 1) compared to MIN_VOLUME input (default 0, effectively disabled by default). 9. Position gate: max 1 position total (if count_buys+count_sells>1, closes all as error), no same-side entry (blocks buy if long exists, blocks sell if short exists).
